## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps

For the wave anchor card (not extracted, not edited here).

**Checklist accuracy**
- ai.agent-tool-skill-metadata-roundtrip: step 2 authors defineAgent in an app package, but compile now WARNS agent-authoring-withdrawn (ADR-0063 §2: 'the runtime filters it out of the agent catalog and refuses to load it') — the agent still lists/reads over /api/v1/meta/agent with _provenance 'package'; the item could name that warning so a runner does not read it as a build failure, and clarify that meta-listing ≠ agent catalog
- ai.agent-tool-skill-metadata-roundtrip: the package-shipped agent PUT answers 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE (distinct from the runtime-name 403 NOT_CREATABLE the revision-5 history cites) — both are refusals
- ai.mcp-http-surface: variants[0] lists the data:read family as list_objects/describe_object/query_records/get_record; live it also carries aggregate_records and validate_expression (both read-only) — the variant list is incomplete, not the product wrong
- ai.mcp-http-surface: OAuth leg runner note: DCR refuses a web client with an http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost redirect ("web clients require https redirect URIs on non-loopback hosts") — register with application_type:"native" to drive the auth-code flow locally
- ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed: query_records limit is capped at 50 on MCP (limit:100 → -32602 "Too big: expected number to be ‹=50") — any step using a larger limit fails input validation, not the gate
- ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate: clause 4 refusal text has two live shapes: with objectName the MCP tool layer answers 'Object "sys_x" is a system object and its actions are not exposed via MCP'; without objectName the runtime guard answers "Action '‹n›' is on a system object and is not exposed via MCP" (the clause's quoted form). Both are the system-object guard; the clause's '…' pattern matches only the second exactly
- ai.skill-instructions-mcp-prompts: fixtures.requires: a runtime-authored skill with instructions+label+description but no `tools` is refused 422 INVALID_METADATA ("tools: expected array, received undefined") — the PUT body needs tools: [] (only the bare fixture, which has tools, saved as written)
- ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport: steps[0]/fixtures (a) need a private address the host holds; this container holds only 192.0.2.2 (TEST-NET-1, not RFC1918), so boot (a) advertised http://10.0.0.5 via OS_AUTH_URL and was probed from localhost — the negative's minimum (advertised origin asserted private) is met, end-to-end private-peer reach was not
- ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure: steps/fixtures: the MCP get_record argument is recordId (id → -32602 "Unrecognized key … Did you mean id → recordId"); apiEnabled is enable.apiEnabled (top-level apiEnabled → 422 unrecognized key) and a runtime object also needs sharingModel (422 security-owd-unset); fixture boot `pnpm dev -- --fresh` was replaced by the canonical dev boot
- ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure: step 3 has no stock-showcase subject: no AI-exposed action is permission-denied for any seeded persona, so the live PERMISSION_DENIED leg needs an authored fixture (ai.exposed action with requiredPermissions)

**Fixture gaps**
- ai.agent-tool-skill-metadata-roundtrip: no stock app ships AI seeds (knownGaps) — satisfied here with a scratch package outside the repo (/tmp/qa18/api-mix/aiapp); compiling it needs a sharingModel on its one object (security-owd-unset author-time rule)
- ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport: no second machine on a private network — step 4 (real MCP client from a peer over http://) not run
- ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure: no AI-exposed, permission-gated action on showcase for the run_action PERMISSION_DENIED live leg
